# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Overview

> 8 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/codes/): The REST APIs support many countries for PayPal account payments if you have a business account.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/): PayPal APIs use REST, authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, and return HTTP response codes and responses encoded in JSON.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing): REST APIs
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/handle-api-responses): Correctly processing API responses ensures that your application can gracefully manage successful payments, declines, errors, and edge cases.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks): Webhooks are HTTPS posts from PayPal to an endpoint on your server whenever the corresponding event type occurs.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/handle-payment-failures): Detect and respond to payment failures using PayPal's Orders v2 API and Subscriptions API.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/get-started): Current PayPal APIs use REST, authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, and return HTTP response codes and JSON responses.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/disputes/): For SDKv6
